covers: The H3 catalog and dry-run response distinguish a project planning contract from a vendor-submittable AutoDL request body, and no longer fabricate ref_image_*/ref_audio_* fields for legacy v5/v2 wrappers.
Image-only planning still selects minimax_h3_lightx2v_v5 and image-plus-audio planning still selects minimax_h3_image_audio_to_video_v2, with hosted URL safety checks and no provider/job side effect.
The source recognizes 1080x1920 as the final delivery target but says the legacy H3 source resolution must be verified per current workflow drawer and cannot be claimed as direct 1080p.
POST /api/comfyui/h3/dry-run remains no-I/O and keeps MINIMAX_H3 as BLOCKED_LOCAL_H3 / DRY_RUN_ONLY.
The two user-supplied workflow IDs remain registered in the selector: minimax_h3_lightx2v_v5 and minimax_h3_image_audio_to_video_v2.
AUTODL_ALLOW_PAID_SUBMIT remains disabled by default, and direct H3 job submission remains blocked with HTTP 409.
A source file or a stale document claims that v5/v2 accepts particular ref_image/ref_audio fields, duration limits, or direct 1080p output without an active workflow drawer verification.
The H3 workflow spec and public docs match the code's unverified-vendor-schema boundary.
